g.text: Positivity thresholds change the numerical reproduction
Same 47 deposited cells at every threshold; no threshold selected to match 74%.
The paper does not specify a Wnt/Pdgfra positivity cutoff. Cell fractions are descriptive, not independent-animal estimates.
